title: A nutrition table printed in several languages shows the app's own names
why: Coach Milan 22 November 2026, 18:43 to 18:46, from an onboarding call: a scanned label showed Greek food names; the pack prints each line in Czech, Croatian, Bulgarian and Greek, joined with slashes, and the app keeps the table as printed. 18:46: yes, a ticket in Next. 23 November 11:17: Draw.

opportunity.job: Check the values of a pack I scanned.
opportunity.kind: Did not understand it: rows named in four languages, Greek among them.
opportunity.why_now: Packs sold across Europe print their table in several languages.

problem: The label read keeps every line of the table as printed, with its printed name. A pack sold in several countries prints each line in several languages, joined with slashes (Tuky/Masti/Мазнини/Λιπαρά for fat). The rows get long and hard to read. And where the first word is in a language the app does not know (Tuky, Sacharidy, Bílkoviny), the app does not see the line, so it adds its own Fat, Carbohydrate and Protein next to it: those lines show twice.
story: When I check the values of a pack I scanned, I want each line named in my language, so that I can read the table at a glance.
proposed: Each line the app knows shows the app's own name in the app's language: Fat, in Srpski Masti. The printed name stays as the record and shows small under it. The app reads every part between the slashes, and knows more languages: Czech, Slovak, Polish, Hungarian, Romanian, Slovenian, Bulgarian and Greek, besides the ones it reads today. So each line shows once. It also knows common vitamins and minerals by name. A line it does not know keeps its printed name, as today. A pack saved before gets the names when it is shown: nothing to scan again.
open: Printed name small under the app's name, as drawn, or behind a tap.
checks: Middle: the label read and the food card. The unit tests with new ones for the line names in every language, the build, a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC6, and the walkthroughs that read or show a label table (label-table, database-photos, tea-zero, camera ones), about 10 to 15 minutes. New words on screen, so the German sweep too.
decision: Direction agreed 22 November 18:46. Drawn 23 November 2026 for Coach Milan's look. No Go, so nothing is built.
now: The card and Review the label show every line as printed. Energetická hodnota/Energetska vrijednost/Енергийна стойност/Ενέργεια is one long row. Tuky/Masti/Мазнини/Λιπαρά 28 g shows, and next to it the app's own Fat 28 g; the same for Carbohydrate and Protein. In Review the label the long names wrap into tall rows.
looked_at: The printed name behind a tap: one tap more for the record, which the coach and the person may want to compare with the pack. Keep only the first language: not chosen, the first may be one the person does not read, and the app would still miss the line.

ac.title: The app's own name, the printed one under it
ac.text: Given a pack whose lines are printed in four languages, Tuky/Masti/Мазнини/Λιπαρά for fat, when I open its card, then the line says Fat, and Tuky/Masti/Мазнини/Λιπαρά shows small under it

ac.title: Each line once
ac.text: Given the same pack, when I open its card, then Fat, Carbohydrate and Protein show once each, with the printed amounts: 28 g, 58 g and 7 g

ac.title: Review the label shows the same
ac.text: Given the same pack, when I tap Review the label, then the lines show the same names, the printed name small under each, and the values can be changed as today

ac.title: In the app's language
ac.text: Given the app in Srpski, when I open the same card, then the lines say Energija, Masti, Ugljeni hidrati, Vlakna, Proteini, So, Kalcijum; in Deutsch Energie, Fett, Kohlenhydrate

ac.title: A line the app does not know
ac.text: Given a line the app does not know, such as Taurin, when the card shows it, then it keeps its printed name, as today; a line printed in the app's own words, such as Protein, shows once with nothing under it

ac.title: A pack saved before
ac.text: Given a pack scanned before this release, when I open its card, then it shows the new names, with nothing to scan again

unchanged: The values and how they are read: the per-100 g column, nulls for trace and less-than.
The order of the lines as printed.
Adding, changing and removing a line in Review the label.
details: Recognising a line: the whole printed name first, then each part between slashes; the of-which words in each language (z toho, od kojih, от които, εκ των οποίων) are dropped first. Short words like Sol and Сол need a word end, so Solubilní does not count as salt.
The app's names come from the words it has (nutrition.row...), new words for the lines and the vitamins and minerals that have none yet, in Srpski and German.
A line saved before with no line found (other:) is read again when it is shown.
The printed name is the record: it is kept as read, never changed.
The pictures are the real app on one scratch build of main, not committed.
short: A table printed in several languages shows the app's own names
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
